description: Optional choices before start_video: the song (a musicId from list_songs; default is Reel-E's first library song), branding ("saved" uses the account's saved brand kit, "none" has no contact card or logo; default is the saved kit when there is one), videoPhotoCount (how many photos the video uses, up to the account's photo limit), pace (cinematic, fast or flow), and the address or listing facts. Each choice is saved on its own: one that cannot be used is listed with the reason and the others still save.

country.description: Country, when outside the United States.

street.description: Street number and name, like '12 Oak Lane'.

unit.description: Unit, apartment or suite, when there is one.

baths.description: Number of bathrooms; halves allowed, like 2.5.

branding.description: saved uses the account's brand kit; none leaves out the contact card and logo.

description.description: The listing description, in the person's words.

musicId.description: The song: a musicId from list_songs.

name.description: A name for a listing with no public address, up to 80 characters.

pace.description: The edit's pace: cinematic, fast or flow.

price.description: List price in dollars, a plain number like 1200000.

videoPhotoCount.description: How many photos the video uses, up to the account's photo limit.

title: Set music, branding and length
